# Youtube (27 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /channel | `channelId` / `handle` / `url` | 1 | Get YouTube channel info |
| /channel/videos | `channelId` / `handle` | 1 | List YouTube channel videos |
| /video | `url` | 1 | Get YouTube video details |
| /videos | `ids` | 5 | Batch get YouTube video details (up to 1000) |
| /channels | `ids` | 5 | Batch get YouTube channel details (up to 1000) |
| /video/sponsors | `url` | 10 | Detect sponsors of a YouTube video |
| /video/comments | `url` | 1 | List YouTube video comments |
| /video/comment/replies | `continuationToken` | 1 | List YouTube comment replies |
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search YouTube |
| /channel/shorts | `channelId` / `handle` | 1 | List YouTube channel shorts |
| /community-post | `url` | 1 | Get YouTube community post |
| /playlist | `playlist_id` | 1 | Get YouTube playlist |
| /search/hashtag | `hashtag` | 1 | Search YouTube by hashtag |
| /shorts/trending | *(none)* | 5 | Get trending YouTube shorts |
| /video/transcript | `url` | **3** | Get YouTube video transcript — ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 3 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.** |
| /channel/playlists | `channelId` / `handle` | 1 | List a YouTube channel's playlists |
| /channel/lives | `channelId` / `handle` | 1 | List a YouTube channel's live streams |
| /channel/community-posts | `channelId` / `handle` | 1 | List a YouTube channel's community posts |
| /videos/trending | *(none)* | 1 | Get trending YouTube videos |
| /playlist/items | `playlist_id` | 1 | List the videos in a YouTube playlist |
| /search/advanced | `query` | 1 | Advanced YouTube video search |
| /search/suggestions | `query` | 1 | Get YouTube search suggestions |
| /video/audio | `url` | 5 | Get a YouTube video's audio file streams |
| /video/files | `url` | 5 | Get a YouTube video's video file streams |
| /video/subtitles | `url` | 1 | Get a YouTube video's subtitle files |
| /video/thumbnails | `url` | 1 | Get a YouTube video's thumbnail files |
| /profile/full | *(none)* | **5** | YouTube profile, recent posts, and computed analytics in one call. |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `channelId` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel ID. Can pass a channelId, handle or url
- `handle` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel handle without the @ symbol
- `url` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel URL. Can pass a channelId, handle or url
- `hl` *(optional, string)*: Preferred response language for localized text (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr').
- `forUsername` *(optional, string)*: Legacy YouTube username (pre-handle) to look up.
- `channelId (/channel/videos)` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel ID
- `sort` *(optional, enum: latest | popular)*: Sort by latest or popular
- `continuationToken` *(optional, string)*: Continuation token to get more videos. Get 'continuationToken' from previous response.
- `includeExtras` *(optional, string)*: This will get you the like + comment count and the description. To get the full details of the video, use the /v1/youtube/video endpoint. This will slow down the response slightly.
- `is_paid_promotions` *(optional, string)*: Set to 'true' to search YouTube's public paid product placement / sponsorship / endorsement surface — returns normal videos where the creator disclosed a paid promotion.
- `url (/video)`: Full URL of the YouTube video
- `language` *(optional, string)*: Preferred response language (mapped to Accept-Language header; not guaranteed due to YouTube localization behavior). 2 letter language code, ie 'en', 'es', 'fr' etc.
- `ids`: JSON array of BARE YouTube video ids (11 characters each, e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'), 1 to 1000 per request. Unlike GET /v1/youtube/video, full watch URLs are not accepted here.
- `hl (/videos)` *(optional, string)*: Preferred response language for localized text (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'en', 'ko').
- `include_localizations` *(optional, boolean)*: When true, includes per-language title/description localizations in each item's ext.
- `ids (/channels)`: JSON array of BARE YouTube channel ids (24 characters, starting with 'UC', e.g. 'UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw'), 1 to 1000 per request. Unlike GET /v1/youtube/channel, channel URLs/handles are not accepted here.
- `hl (/channels)` *(optional, string)*: Preferred response language for localized text (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'en', 'ko').
- `include_localizations (/channels)` *(optional, boolean)*: When true, includes per-language localizations in each item's ext.
- `url (/video/sponsors)`: Full URL of the YouTube video or short
- `language (/video/sponsors)` *(optional, string)*: 2 letter language code used for transcript lookup, ie 'en', 'es', 'fr' etc.
- `url (/video/comments)`: Full URL of the YouTube video to fetch comments for
- `continuationToken (/video/comments)` *(optional, string)*: Continuation token to get more comments. Get 'continuationToken' from previous response.
- `order` *(optional, enum: top | newest)*: Order of comments
- `searchTerm` *(optional, string)*: Filter comments to those containing this search term.
- `format` *(optional, enum: html | plainText)*: Text format for comment bodies — 'html' (default) or 'plainText'.
- `max_results` *(optional, integer)*: Maximum number of comments to return per page.
- `channel_id` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel id to fetch channel-level community comments for (instead of a video's comments).
- `continuationToken (/video/comment/replies)`: Continuation token for the comment replies. Use 'repliesContinuationToken' from the Comments endpoint, or 'continuationToken' from a previous replies response to paginate.
- `format (/video/comment/replies)` *(optional, enum: html | plainText)*: Text format for reply bodies — 'html' (default) or 'plainText'.
- `query`: Search keyword or phrase.
- `uploadDate` *(optional, enum: today | this_week | this_month | this_year)*: Upload date filter.
- `sortBy` *(optional, enum: relevance | popular)*: Sort order — relevance or popular.
- `type` *(optional, enum: videos | shorts | channels | playlists)*: Type of content to return.
- `duration` *(optional, enum: under_3_min | between_3_and_20_min | over_20_min)*: Video duration filter. Only applies to videos (not shorts).
- `region` *(optional, string)*: 2-letter country code of the country to put the proxy in.
- `continuationToken (/search)` *(optional, string)*: Continuation token to get more results. Get `continuationToken` from a previous response.
- `includeExtras (/search)` *(optional, string)*: Set to `true` to include like + comment count and description. For full per-video details use `/v1/youtube/video`. Slows the response slightly.
- `channelId (/channel/shorts)` *(optional, string)*: Can pass channelId or handle

- `handle (/channel/playlists)` *(optional, string)*: YouTube channel handle (with or without @).

- `event_type` *(optional, string)*: Broadcast type: live, upcoming, completed.
- `license` *(optional, string)*: License filter: creativeCommon, youtube, any.
- `category (/search/advanced)` *(optional, string)*: YouTube video category id (e.g. 10 = Music).
- `region (/search/advanced)` *(optional, string)*: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `language (/search/advanced)` *(optional, string)*: Preferred result language (ISO 639-1).
- `published_after` *(optional, string)*: RFC-3339 datetime lower bound (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z).
- `published_before` *(optional, string)*: RFC-3339 datetime upper bound.
- `channel_id (/search/advanced)` *(optional, string)*: Restrict results to a single channel id.
- `max_results (/search/advanced)` *(optional, integer)*: Maximum number of videos to return (1–50).
- `safe_search` *(optional, string)*: Safe-search filter: none, moderate, strict.
- `video_caption` *(optional, string)*: Caption filter: any, closedCaption, none.
- `video_definition` *(optional, string)*: Quality filter: any, high, standard.
- `video_dimension` *(optional, string)*: Dimension filter: 2d, 3d, any.
- `video_embeddable` *(optional, string)*: Restrict to embeddable videos: true, any.

- `posts` *(optional, integer)*: How many recent posts to fetch + average the computed metrics over (1–100, default 25).

## Field Maps


The `channel` endpoint returns an `Author` response normalized by the `youtube-author` field map, and `video` returns a `Post` normalized by `youtube-post`. Both include computed fields (`engagement_rate`, `language`, `content_category`, `estimated_reach`) under `data.computed`. Use `?format=raw` to bypass both and get the upstream JSON. Other YouTube endpoints are passthrough.


## Caption files vs transcription (cost note)

`video/subtitles` (1cr) returns the **caption file** — it is NOT a compute-transcript
endpoint and is NOT banned. YouTube subtitle files are **real spoken-word transcripts**
(unlike IG post captions, which are never a transcript substitute). Legit use: the paid
fallback rung in the YouTube subtitle chain when `yt-dlp` is blocked on a machine
(e.g. antivirus):
yt-dlp subtitles (free) → `video/subtitles` (1cr) → Groq → local Whisper.
`video/transcript` (3cr) stays banned — the chain above always wins.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/youtube/channel?" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
